verdict.rationale: The only calendar-related evidence is a single mention that AgentMail's hosted MCP server exposes "calendar tools". Nothing documents sharing availability or inserting bookable meeting times into an email. Other versions of the same MCP doc list no calendar tools at all. This is an adjacent, unspecified capability, not the story itself, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email

citations.quote: exposes inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment, and calendar tools to any compatible client
